messages:
maria: heads-up 1: found a couple problems while trying to follow the "hello-mini" quickstart for onboarding. the docker compose example mounts .env but the variable name differs between the README and the starter app. also the Deploy step links to a 404 on the deploy checklist. opening a tiny PR that adjusts env names, adds a short troubleshooting section, and patches the link. cc @chris @ash

chris: thanks, can you paste the two variants you saw? i'll grep the starter repo to see where the mismatch originated. :mag:

maria: sure  current README snippet (incorrect):

```bash
# README shows
REDWOOD_KEY=sk-...
docker compose up
```

but the starter app expects REDWOOD_API_KEY. changed README to use REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere and added a one-line shim in the starter app that reads either var for backwards compat. also documented the recommended env name in the Quickstart note.

ash: nice backward-compat idea. small UX ask: can we add a warning banner in the quickstart page so folks see it before they run compose? many folks copy/paste quickly. :warning:

maria: added a short banner above the "Start the app" step that reads: "Pro-tip: use REDWOOD_API_KEY. If you have REDWOOD_KEY set, the starter will still work but we recommend migrating." also added a 1-line migration helper for CI: `env | grep REDWOOD`

dev-rel-bot: PR #428 opened by maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428 - includes: README env rename, quickstart banner, tests: compose-smoke and linkcheck. status: running tests.

chris: also noted the Node example still imports from `@redwood/client` older path. can you drop a tiny SDK migration snippet showing new import and the equivalent curl header? e.g. `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` -> `const rw = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` and curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

maria: added a 2-line SDK migration note in the quickstart and linked to the full SDK upgrade guide. replaced the bad deploy checklist link (was /docs/deploy-checklist-old) with /docs/deploy/checklist and filed a quick redirect request with the docs infra team.

link-bot: Automated check: old link /docs/deploy-checklist-old -> 404. New link /docs/deploy/checklist -> 200.

ash: once CI green, let's also update the starter app's README.md in the repo root so the GitHub preview shows the correct env var. after merge i'll run a tiny canary on the onboarding pipeline.

maria: will do. merging on green and will post an announcement in #all-hands after merge so support knows to expect fewer env-related tickets. thanks everyone. :tada:
